rationale.conceptual: The method uses DFTB with revised periodic boundary conditions to model bending, which is a specialized, multi-component technique from computational nanoscience. Understanding the needed concepts (geometry generation, tight-binding parametrization, k-point sampling, band gap extraction) goes beyond standard textbook knowledge and requires genuine domain understanding, though the core equations are established.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves generating multiple bent geometries, running DFTB optimizations with very tight force criteria (10^-5 eV/Å), computing band structures, and aggregating results across many configurations. This requires orchestrating an external code (hotbit), handling convergence issues, and careful parameterization—a multi-stage, fragile workflow typical of a research-grade reproduction.
